{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "8dcc710198847a969f4cb0434352cddfd1cd10613cae5bb844c19ad8118c14c5",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"LocalDef001","meaning":"For every real x and t, both partial derivatives of q exist and their values satisfy q_t + speed • q_x = 0.","effect_on_target":"The first conditional equivalence requires this pointwise differential condition everywhere for real-valued q.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"LocalDef002","meaning":"There exist a real-valued eigenvalue family and a real basis of the coordinate vector space, indexed by the matrix index type, such that each basis vector is an eigenvector with its corresponding eigenvalue.","effect_on_target":"Asserts existence of a real eigenbasis for the one-by-one matrix with entry speed; neither orthonormality nor distinct eigenvalues is required.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"LocalDef003","meaning":"Every spatial slice of q is integrable on every finite interval; every temporal slice of flux composed with q is integrable on every finite interval; and for all a,b,s,t, the spatial integral at t minus that at s equals the temporal integral from s to t of flux(q(a,τ)) minus flux(q(b,τ)).","effect_on_target":"The second conditional equivalence uses all three requirements with scalar flux u ↦ speed*u.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"LocalDef004","meaning":"For every real x,t, q(x + speed*t,t) = q(x,0).","effect_on_target":"This pointwise transport identity is the sole explicit hypothesis for both final equivalences; equivalently q(x,t)=q(x-speed*t,0).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"LocalDef005","meaning":"The matrix indexed by Fin 1 in both directions whose sole entry is speed.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the coefficient matrix to the one-dimensional scalar matrix [speed].","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"LocalDef006","meaning":"An abbreviation for LocalDef009 on vectors indexed by Fin m.","effect_on_target":"Introduces exactly the vector partial-derivative condition, specialized to m=1, without additional conditions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"LocalDef007","meaning":"An abbreviation for LocalDef010 for a real-valued function.","effect_on_target":"The right side of the unconditional pointwise equivalence is existence of scalar partial derivatives satisfying q_t + speed*q_x = 0.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"LocalDef008","meaning":"Embeds q(x,t) as the function on Fin 1 with that value at its only coordinate.","effect_on_target":"Identifies the scalar field with a one-component vector field.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"LocalDef009","meaning":"There exist coordinate vectors qt and qx that are respectively the derivatives of τ ↦ q(x,τ) at t and ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) at x, and qt + coefficient.mulVec(qx) = 0.","effect_on_target":"Requires actual derivatives, with witnesses chosen for the given field and point; in dimension one its equation becomes the scalar transport equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"LocalDef010","meaning":"There exist qt,qx in the real normed vector space E that are the temporal and spatial slice derivatives at the specified point, and qt + speed • qx = 0.","effect_on_target":"Defines the scalar differential condition at E=Real, both pointwise and under universal quantification over space and time.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"LocalDef011","meaning":"Real scalar multiplication on any real coordinate function space is jointly continuous.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the continuity structure needed for vector-valued HasDerivAt; it imposes no regularity assumption on q.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"LocalDef012","meaning":"Scalar multiplication is jointly continuous in every real normed vector space.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the continuity structure for scalar or normed-space derivative predicates, without assuming continuity of q.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"And","meaning":"Logical conjunction.","effect_on_target":"All three main assertions hold together; both final equivalences hold together, and each derivative or integral predicate includes all its listed clauses.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField","meaning":"Retains a densely normed field's normed field structure and supplies nontriviality of its norm.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real scalar-field structure needed by differentiability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"Differentiable","meaning":"Differentiability at every point of the entire domain over the specified scalar field.","effect_on_target":"Requires the initial profile x ↦ q(x,0) to be differentiable at every real x, without requiring a continuous derivative.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"Fin","meaning":"The type of natural numbers strictly less than its natural-number parameter.","effect_on_target":"Fin 1 is the singleton coordinate index set {0}.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"Fin.fintype","meaning":"Enumerates all indices in Fin n as a finite type.","effect_on_target":"Enables finite matrix-vector sums and the basis indexing for the sole coordinate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"HMul.hMul","meaning":"The multiplication operation provided by the chosen heterogeneous multiplication instance.","effect_on_target":"At the supplied real instances, speed*state and speed*t are ordinary real products.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"Iff","meaning":"Logical equivalence, asserting both implications.","effect_on_target":"Each of the three equivalence claims is bidirectional.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace","meaning":"Extracts the normed vector-space structure from an inner product space.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real normed-space structure for scalar derivatives and integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"IntervalIntegrable","meaning":"Integrability on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the specified measure.","effect_on_target":"Handles arbitrary endpoint order and means finite-interval Lebesgue integrability for the real functions in the target.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume","meaning":"Extracts the distinguished measure of a measure-space instance.","effect_on_target":"Selects real volume, namely Lebesgue measure, for the integrability requirements and integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"Nat","meaning":"The natural numbers including zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the dimension parameter 1 and natural numeral indices.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity while retaining the same seminormed ring operations.","effect_on_target":"Participates in obtaining the usual real seminormed additive structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains the ring's norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Provides the unchanged additive and topological structure used for real normed-space instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup","meaning":"Forgets additive commutativity while retaining the norm, group operations, and metric.","effect_on_target":"Supports the extended-norm structure used to express integrability of real functions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Views a normed additive commutative group as seminormed using the same norm and pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the usual real analytic structures while supplying weaker required instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Uses a normed additive group's norm as an extended nonnegative norm, retaining addition and zero.","effect_on_target":"Makes real absolute-value integrability available to IntervalIntegrable.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains a normed commutative ring's operations and norm as a seminormed commutative ring.","effect_on_target":"Leaves real arithmetic and topology unchanged in the differentiability structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"NormedSpace.toModule","meaning":"Extracts the scalar module structure from a normed space.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real scalar multiplication for differentiability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"OfNat.ofNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural numeral in a type using its numeral instance.","effect_on_target":"Interprets dimension 1 in Nat and the initial time 0 in Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace","meaning":"Extracts the uniform structure of a pseudometric space.","effect_on_target":"Transfers the ordinary real metric to the topology used by differentiability and integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal","meaning":"Regards an RCLike field as a real inner product space with its induced norm and real inner product.","effect_on_target":"For Real this supplies its ordinary one-dimensional real normed-space structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"Real","meaning":"The real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Speed, space, time, interval endpoints, scalar values, and eigenvalues are all real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"Real.denselyNormedField","meaning":"The usual real normed field together with density of its norm values in positive intervals.","effect_on_target":"Provides the nontrivially normed scalar field for real calculus.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"Real.instAddCommGroup","meaning":"The additive commutative group structure on the reals.","effect_on_target":"Supplies usual real addition, subtraction, and zero in the analytic predicates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"Real.instMul","meaning":"Real multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the flux and characteristic displacement to ordinary multiplication by speed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"Real.instRCLike","meaning":"The real RCLike structure, with real part the identity, imaginary part zero, and the ordinary complete normed real algebra.","effect_on_target":"Provides standard real analytic structures; no complex-valued states or eigenvalues are introduced.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"Real.instZero","meaning":"The real number zero.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the distinguished initial time and scalar zero in equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"Real.measureSpace","meaning":"The standard measure-space instance on the reals, whose volume is Lebesgue measure.","effect_on_target":"All target integrability statements and interval integrals use real Lebesgue measure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"Real.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"The real additive group equipped with its usual norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Gives the scalar codomain its usual analysis and integration structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"Real.normedCommRing","meaning":"The ordinary real commutative ring with its usual norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Provides compatible ring and seminormed structures without changing the real operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"Real.normedField","meaning":"The ordinary real field with its usual norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the scalar field and norm for real differentiability and normed-space structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"Real.pseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"The real pseudometric with distance |x-y|.","effect_on_target":"Ensures the derivatives and integrability predicates use the usual real topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains the operations, norm, and pseudometric while forgetting the unit requirement.","effect_on_target":"Supplies a weaker real structure used in building the normed-space instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace","meaning":"Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.","effect_on_target":"Provides the ordinary real topology to the target's analytic predicates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"Zero.toOfNat0","meaning":"Interprets the numeral 0 using a type's zero element.","effect_on_target":"The initial trace q(x,0) is evaluated at real zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"instHMul","meaning":"Uses a type's multiplication as homogeneous heterogeneous multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Resolves the displayed products to real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"instOfNatNat","meaning":"Interprets each natural numeral as itself in Nat.","effect_on_target":"The coordinate dimension is exactly the natural number one.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive monoid, negation, and subtraction structure of an additive group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies ordinary subtraction in the balance-law expression.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"Algebra.id","meaning":"A commutative semiring acts as an algebra over itself through the identity map, with scalar action given by multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Identifies real scalar multiplication on real states with real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"Algebra.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts the scalar action from an algebra.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real-on-real scalar action used in the differential equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing","meaning":"Retains commutative ring operations while forgetting the unit structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides real algebraic instances needed for matrix multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"CommSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts the underlying semiring of a commutative semiring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies standard real semiring operations for bases and modules.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"DFunLike.coe","meaning":"Coerces a function-like object to its underlying function.","effect_on_target":"Allows structured maps such as a basis representation inverse to be evaluated.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"Eq","meaning":"Equality of two objects of the same type.","effect_on_target":"All transport, eigenvector, derivative-balance, and integral-balance equalities are exact, not almost-everywhere equalities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"Exists","meaning":"Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.","effect_on_target":"Introduces eigenvalues and a basis for each speed, and derivative values separately for each function and point.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"Fintype","meaning":"A finite type structure giving a complete finite collection of elements.","effect_on_target":"Allows matrix-vector products to sum over all coordinate indices; here there is exactly one.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"Function.hasSMul","meaning":"Scalar multiplication of functions inherited pointwise from their values.","effect_on_target":"Vector eigenvalue multiplication and vector scalar actions are coordinatewise.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"HAdd.hAdd","meaning":"The addition operation of the selected heterogeneous addition instance.","effect_on_target":"Expresses ordinary real addition in x+speed*t and coordinatewise addition in vector equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"HSMul.hSMul","meaning":"The scalar-action operation of the selected instance.","effect_on_target":"Expresses multiplication of derivative vectors or basis vectors by real scalars.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"HSub.hSub","meaning":"The subtraction operation of the selected instance.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the signs of the time-slice difference and the left-boundary minus right-boundary flux.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"Matrix","meaning":"A matrix is a function from a row index and a column index to an entry.","effect_on_target":"The coefficient is a function Fin 1 → Fin 1 → Real with constant value speed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"Matrix.mulVec","meaning":"The i-th coordinate of Mv is the finite dot product of row i of M with v, namely the sum of M(i,j)*v(j).","effect_on_target":"For the singleton matrix [speed], matrix-vector multiplication multiplies its only vector coordinate by speed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"Module.Basis","meaning":"An indexed basis of a module, providing unique finite coordinate representations of its elements.","effect_on_target":"The existential eigenbasis spans the entire real coordinate space and is linearly independent; it is not merely an arbitrary family of eigenvectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"Module.Basis.instFunLike","meaning":"Evaluates a basis at an index by applying its inverse coordinate representation to the finitely supported unit coordinate vector.","effect_on_target":"The eigenvector equations apply to actual basis vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing","meaning":"Retains the same ring operations and commutativity while forgetting associativity requirements.","effect_on_target":"Supplies weaker real algebraic structure for matrix-vector products.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity while keeping the same operations.","effect_on_target":"Continues the real instance chain for finite matrix arithmetic.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Retains addition, zero, multiplication, and distributivity while forgetting additive inverses.","effect_on_target":"Provides precisely the real operations used by Matrix.mulVec.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"NormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"An additive commutative group with a norm and compatible metric.","effect_on_target":"The generalized local definitions require this codomain structure, instantiated in the target by the usual reals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup","meaning":"Extracts the additive group from a normed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Provides the same addition, negation, and subtraction in the integral balance law.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"NormedField.toNormedSpace","meaning":"A normed field is a normed vector space over itself with scalar action given by multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Supports the usual scalar real derivative structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"NormedSpace","meaning":"A scalar module over a normed field with a compatible seminorm bound for scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"The target uses the ordinary real normed vector space rather than an arbitrary codomain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"Pi.Function.module","meaning":"The module of functions with pointwise addition and scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Gives Fin 1 → Real its ordinary one-dimensional real vector-space structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"Pi.addCommMonoid","meaning":"The additive commutative monoid on a function space induced pointwise.","effect_on_target":"Provides coordinatewise addition and zero for the vector-space basis and matrix equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"Real.commRing","meaning":"The usual commutative ring of real numbers, with its standard arithmetic and numeral embeddings.","effect_on_target":"Ensures all matrix and scalar algebra uses ordinary real arithmetic.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"Real.instAdd","meaning":"Real addition.","effect_on_target":"Determines the characteristic displacement x+speed*t and scalar derivative sum.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"Real.instAddCommMonoid","meaning":"The ordinary additive commutative monoid of real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real addition and zero for vector modules and finite sums.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"Real.instCommSemiring","meaning":"The ordinary real commutative semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Supports the real self-algebra and scalar actions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"Real.semiring","meaning":"The ordinary real semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the algebraic base for real bases and modules.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"Extracts the compatible pseudometric from a seminormed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the topology used for derivatives and integrals without introducing a new domain restriction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"Semiring.toModule","meaning":"A semiring is a module over itself using multiplication as scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Real scalar action on scalar states is ordinary multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"SubNegMonoid.toSub","meaning":"Extracts subtraction from the additive structure with subtraction and negation.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the subtraction used in the integral and flux differences.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"instHAdd","meaning":"Uses a type's addition as its homogeneous heterogeneous addition.","effect_on_target":"Resolves the sums to ordinary scalar or pointwise vector addition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"instHSMul","meaning":"Uses a scalar action as the corresponding heterogeneous scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Resolves the scalar multiplications in eigenvector and derivative equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"instHSub","meaning":"Uses a type's subtraction as homogeneous heterogeneous subtraction.","effect_on_target":"Resolves all displayed differences to their usual subtraction operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"intervalIntegral","meaning":"The integral on (a,b] minus the integral on (b,a], with the supplied measure.","effect_on_target":"All balance-law integrals are oriented; swapping endpoints reverses the sign, and equal endpoints give zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D088","name":"AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Retains an additive commutative group's subtraction and negation structure as a subtraction commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supports the inherited zero, negation, and subtraction in the derivative and integral predicates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D089","name":"AddCommMagma.toAdd","meaning":"Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.","effect_on_target":"Provides the inherited addition used in derivative equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D090","name":"AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup","meaning":"Retains associative commutative addition while forgetting the zero requirement.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the same addition in the algebraic instance chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D091","name":"AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma","meaning":"Retains commutative addition while forgetting associativity requirements.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the same scalar or vector addition operation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D092","name":"AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass","meaning":"Retains addition, zero, and their identity laws.","effect_on_target":"Supports the zero element used in the transport equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D093","name":"AddZero.toZero","meaning":"Extracts the zero element from an additive structure with zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the scalar or vector zero on the right side of the derivative equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D094","name":"AddZeroClass.toAddZero","meaning":"Retains addition and zero while forgetting the identity-law fields.","effect_on_target":"Continues the instance chain supplying the unchanged zero element.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D095","name":"DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul","meaning":"Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.","effect_on_target":"Supports the linear scalar actions in derivative and eigenvector equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D096","name":"DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass","meaning":"Extracts a scalar action that preserves zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the same scalar multiplication through a weaker structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D097","name":"DivisionSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts the semiring operations from a division semiring.","effect_on_target":"Provides unchanged real addition and multiplication for analytic module structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D098","name":"ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Retains an extended norm and commutative addition while forgetting norm separation.","effect_on_target":"Supplies weaker structures for integration without changing the real norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D099","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts commutative addition and zero from an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Provides the addition and zero underlying integrability and integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D100","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Forgets additive commutativity while preserving the extended seminorm and additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the integration machinery's required normed additive structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D101","name":"ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive monoid from an extended-seminormed additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the addition and zero used in integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D102","name":"Field.toSemifield","meaning":"Retains a field's semiring and multiplicative inverse structures while forgetting additive inverses.","effect_on_target":"Provides weaker real field instances; no nonzero-speed hypothesis is introduced.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D103","name":"HasDerivAt","meaning":"The function has the specified derivative at the specified point in the full ambient scalar domain, using the neighborhood of that point.","effect_on_target":"Both slice derivatives must exist at each point under consideration; these are ordinary two-sided real derivatives, not formal derivative values or almost-everywhere derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D104","name":"Module.toDistribMulAction","meaning":"Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the usual scalar action in the normed-space derivative predicates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D105","name":"NegZeroClass.toZero","meaning":"Extracts zero from a structure with negation preserving zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the same zero used in the derivative balance.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D106","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts commutative addition and zero from a possibly nonunital, nonassociative semiring.","effect_on_target":"Supports the finite sums in matrix-vector multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D107","name":"NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the norm and retains the nonunital commutative ring operations.","effect_on_target":"Supplies ordinary real algebraic operations to matrix arithmetic.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D108","name":"NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Retains the same semiring operations while forgetting multiplicative associativity requirements.","effect_on_target":"Provides a weaker real structure sufficient for Matrix.mulVec.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D109","name":"NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField","meaning":"Extracts the underlying normed field.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the ordinary real scalar field used by HasDerivAt.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D110","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative group from a normed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Provides the additive codomain structure for differentiation and integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D111","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Uses the group's norm as an extended norm and retains commutative addition.","effect_on_target":"Provides real norm-based integrability for the local integral predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D112","name":"NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains the norm, metric, and commutative ring operations while forgetting the unit requirement.","effect_on_target":"Supplies compatible weaker real structures for the dependency chain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D113","name":"NormedField.toField","meaning":"Extracts the field structure from a normed field.","effect_on_target":"Ensures scalar algebra in derivative predicates is the usual real field algebra.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D114","name":"Pi.addCommGroup","meaning":"The additive commutative group on a function space with pointwise operations.","effect_on_target":"Provides the coordinate vector codomain's additive structure for vector derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D115","name":"Pi.instAdd","meaning":"Function addition is defined coordinatewise by (f+g)(i)=f(i)+g(i).","effect_on_target":"The vector differential equation is a coordinatewise equality.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D116","name":"Pi.instZero","meaning":"The zero function has zero at every coordinate.","effect_on_target":"The zero in the vector equation is the one-component zero vector.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D117","name":"Pi.topologicalSpace","meaning":"The product topology on a function space, generated through all coordinate evaluations.","effect_on_target":"Vector derivatives use the standard product topology on Fin 1 → Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D118","name":"Real.instMonoid","meaning":"The ordinary multiplicative monoid of real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Supports scalar multiplication actions, including multiplication by zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D119","name":"Real.instRing","meaning":"The ordinary ring structure of the reals.","effect_on_target":"Provides standard real algebra for scalar derivative structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D120","name":"Ring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts a ring's semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Retains real addition, multiplication, zero, and one for module constructions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D121","name":"SMulZeroClass.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts scalar multiplication from a scalar action preserving zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the same scalar operation in derivative equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D122","name":"Semifield.toDivisionSemiring","meaning":"Retains the division semiring structure while forgetting multiplicative commutativity requirements.","effect_on_target":"Supports the real scalar structure without restricting speed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D123","name":"Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring","meaning":"Retains semiring operations while forgetting the unit requirement.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the weaker real algebraic structure used by matrix multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D124","name":"SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass","meaning":"Retains zero, negation, and the law that negation fixes zero.","effect_on_target":"Supports the inherited zero used in scalar derivative equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D125","name":"SubtractionCommMonoid.toSubtractionMonoid","meaning":"Forgets additive commutativity while retaining subtraction structure.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the subtraction and zero operations in the analytic predicates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D126","name":"SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid","meaning":"Retains the subtraction and negation structure and supplies that negation fixes zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides a compatible zero structure, without adding a hypothesis on q.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D127","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Retains commutative addition and zero while forgetting inverse requirements.","effect_on_target":"Supplies additive structures for modules, vectors, and integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D128","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddGroup","meaning":"Forgets additive commutativity while retaining the same additive group.","effect_on_target":"Supports the unchanged subtraction and zero structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D129","name":"AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive monoid from an additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Preserves addition and zero throughout the scalar and vector instance chains.","status":"understood"},
